title: Three-tier PR contract: entrypoint discipline on publication-bundle currency
intent: Finish PR #1234 on top of #1233: Decapod-owned entrypoints verify early and bump only on version/pin mismatch; living specs require unique material rewrites; governance JSON updates every project PR; no per-commit full-bundle churn.
proof_hooks: ENTRYPOINT_COMMIT_DISCIPLINE rejects hand edits and mode-only entrypoint touches
Same-version project PRs leave entrypoints untouched when pins match evaluating binary
GOVERNANCE_PR_UPDATES requires all four governance files in base...HEAD
PUBLICATION_BUNDLE_CURRENCY remains HEAD currency (no per-commit path participation)
stop_conditions: Stop if migration or validation cannot establish a clean verified state.
